name: Display Case
intro: [placeholder] A glass-topped case, locked. Something is inside.

passives.line: [placeholder] Dust on the glass, but the dust is wrong. Someone wiped it recently, then breathed on it.
[placeholder] The case is humming. Not the building. The case.
[placeholder] Whoever locked this up wanted it kept from people like you.
[placeholder] You used to build things that sat behind glass. Admired. Unused.
[placeholder] (A passive check you can't pass yet. It stays silent.)

actives.label: Work out how the lock is built
actives.success: [placeholder] Three pins and a bad idea. You see how it opens.
actives.failure: [placeholder] The mechanism folds into itself. You lose the thread.

actives.label: Jimmy it open with a paperclip
actives.success: [placeholder] The lock gives with a crunch. It will never close again.
actives.failure: [placeholder] The paperclip snaps in the lock. That door is closed for good.

actives.label: Lift the whole case by its edges
actives.success: [placeholder] It shifts. Something under it clicks.
actives.failure: [placeholder] It weighs more than it has any right to.
